designSummary: Descriptive charting with a narrative summary of outcomes by engagement level.
sampleSize: Not a sample: all eligible studies are included; the library's preliminary count suggests 60 to 120 reports to screen at full text.
primaryAnalysis: Tables of adherence and seizure outcomes by engagement level, summarised narratively where at least three studies report the same outcome.
missingData: Items not reported are charted as not reported.
software: Reference manager and spreadsheet charting form.
summary: Descriptive synthesis organised around outcomes by engagement level.
